a:
Create a production pixel sprite animation atlas, transparent background. Match the supplied K119 worker reference EXACTLY in costume, face, size, proportions, palette and chunky pixel outline. This is a new animation extension, NOT a character redesign. Native intended figure 73 logical pixels tall, head ~24, stout boots. Strong dark 1 logical px outline, discrete ~3 tones per material, directional upper-left light, NO airbrush, gradients, bloom, neon, glossy polish, missing mouth or noisy decorative pixels.
OUTPUT atlas 1536x2560, exactly 8 equal columns and 10 equal rows (each tile192x256, intended 2x native 96x128). All bodies centered x96, planted sole baseline y240; normal upright head y96 (73 logical pixels above sole). Fixed identical body scale ALL frames. Hands gripping an INVISIBLE HORIZONTAL BAR at chest-height y180 (native y90), not palms pushing an imaginary wall; fists with fingers curled downward around shaft, both hands steady at same height. Do NOT DRAW BAR, wheel, machine, oil can, ground, shadows, labels or grid. Each frame distinct articulated limb pose. Maintain feet contact, no root jitter.
Rows numbered top to bottom:
1 PUSH FRONT 8 frames, both forearms forward towards viewer, elbows bent, fists spaced across chest at y180; short heavy alternating steps.
2 PUSH BACK 8 frames, hands ahead hidden partly by upper torso, visible knuckles beside torso, slight forward lean, alternating loaded steps.
3 PUSH RIGHT PROFILE 8 frames, two arms forward at chest height, bent elbows, clenched grip hands projecting right, torso modest forward lean, short loaded stepping, distinct supporting and passing leg phases.
4 START FRONT 3 frames columns1-3 only: arms low reaching, arms lifting to chest, settled gripping push stance. cols4-8 empty.
5 START BACK same 3.
6 START RIGHT same 3.
7 STOP/REST FRONT 3 frames cols1-3 only: release grip, raise right forearm to wipe brow, lower arm to relaxed rest. Distinct readable wipe on forehead.
8 STOP/REST BACK 3 frames same wipe brow visible above shoulder.
9 STOP/REST RIGHT 3 frames same wipe brow, arm touching forehead then lowered.
10 STRAIN RIGHT 8 frames, faster capstan turning: markedly deeper torso forward lean, head lowered and brow furrowed, BOTH arms still gripping invisible bar at same y180, flexed knees and alternating forceful short strides. Different silhouette from row3, no effects or sweat particles.
Use clear transparent gutters between every tile and every row. Left facings will be mirrored. This atlas must fit all requested rows; do not skip rows or add frames.
Worker A only: brown receding short hair with grey temples, brown moustache and short brown beard, cream sleeveless undershirt, rusty orange-brown leather apron, charcoal trousers, brown boots. Reference images are K119 front/back/right walk; preserve their identity.
